title: A Promise for the Garden
premise: Marine biologist Yara Winterbourne has spent seven years on a remote island research station training herself out of feeling, counting sea turtles instead of the heartbreak she left behind in Boston. When a freak October snowstorm strands her with Elias Marsh — the rival scientist who broke her heart at twenty-six — and his fiancée, she is forced to confront the night everything fell apart and the secret promise that bound all three of them. As the storm traps them together, old truths surface: Elias never stopped loving her, the fiancée knew, and Yara's own guilt over a betrayal she committed first has been the real cage. By the time the last ferry of the season arrives, Yara must choose between the safe, contained life she engineered and the messy, unforgiven love still standing in front of her — and she finally forgives herself enough to board it with him.
about_author: Astrid Halloran is a former field researcher who traded tide charts for typewriters after one too many winters on remote islands. She writes love stories about people who are very good at surviving and very bad at living.

chapters.title: Counting Instead of Feeling
chapters.summary: Yara's POV. On Gullwrack Island, Yara logs the season's final turtle nests and rehearses her philosophy: the heart is a trainable muscle. A supply boat delivers an unexpected passenger list for the closing-week symposium — including Elias Marsh's name. Emotional beat: controlled calm cracking at the edges.

chapters.title: The Man Who Stayed Ashore
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. Elias arrives with his fiancée Priya, telling himself seven years and one ring have settled old debts. He and Yara exchange flawless professional courtesies while their hands shake. Flashback threads hint at a broken promise neither will name. Emotional beat: dread dressed as politeness.

chapters.title: Snow Before Its Season
chapters.summary: Priya's POV. The earliest storm in island history seals the harbor; the ferry cancels indefinitely. Priya watches her fiancé and his ex orbit each other and realizes she isn't the outsider she assumed — she knows something about that night they don't know she knows. Emotional beat: quiet, dangerous clarity.

chapters.title: What the Tide Took
chapters.summary: Yara's POV. Storm damage forces Yara, Elias, and Priya to rescue stranded hatchlings together, and forced proximity strips away performance. An argument in the boathouse cracks open the night of the breakup — but Yara stops short of confessing her own betrayal. Emotional beat: grief resurfacing as anger.

chapters.title: The Promise in the Dunes
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. Power out, Elias tells Priya the full story of the promise he made Yara's dying mentor — to protect her career, even from himself, by walking away. Priya reveals she has known for two years. Emotional beat: relief and terror entangled; duty examined and found wanting.

chapters.title: Muscle Memory
chapters.summary: Yara's POV. Yara discovers Elias's notebook of seven years of letters never sent, each one ending with the same unsent question. She almost goes to him, then finds Priya waiting instead — not to fight, but to tell her the truth about who betrayed whom that night. Emotional beat: the ground giving way.

chapters.title: Three at the Window
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. The storm peaks; the three sit through a blackout dinner where every card is finally on the table — Yara's falsified data report that ruined Elias's grant, done to save his reputation from her mentor's error. Rage, laughter, and tears share the same table. Emotional beat: catharsis without resolution.

chapters.title: Justice Outside the Law
chapters.summary: Elias's POV. Morning after, Elias chooses honesty over protection: he drafts a statement correcting the record on the mentor's error, knowing it may end both careers. Yara begs him not to pay her penance for her. Emotional beat: love measured against duty, duty losing.

chapters.title: The Last Ferry of the Season
chapters.summary: Yara's POV. The ferry horn sounds across thawing water. Yara stands at the dock with her bags packed for Boston and realizes forgiveness was never Elias's to give her — it was hers. She asks Priya, not Elias, what she should do; Priya laughs and says board it or don't. Emotional beat: the mirror finally faced.

chapters.title: A Promise for the Garden
chapters.summary: Yara and Elias's shared POV, alternating. They stay through winter, planting the mentor's memorial garden above the nesting beach, filing the truth together and accepting whatever comes. Epilogue in spring: hatchlings race to the sea as the first ferry returns, carrying two names on one manifest. Emotional beat: earned, uncontained hope.
